positive: Enter a number greater than zero.
futureDate: That date is in the future.
symbolNeedsMarket: A symbol needs its market — the same letters are two instruments on two venues.
quantityPositive: Quantity must be greater than zero.
periodOrder: The period starts after it ends.
duplicateCurrency: Each currency can only have one balance.
returnTargetHasNoCurrency: A return target is a percentage and has no currency.
returnTargetRange: Enter a return target as a percentage, up to 1000.
sellReasonOnlyOnSell: A sell reason only applies to a sell review.
entryNeedsSymbol: An entry attached to a transaction needs its symbol.
publicNeedsSlug: A public portfolio needs a public address.
onlyPublicIndexed: Only a public portfolio can be indexed.
reconciliationNeedsRows: Add at least one position or balance to compare against.
cashKindRequired: Choose what kind of movement this is.
reasonRequired: A financial change needs a reason.
